name: walled-shallow-shade
why: A cone that lies nearly flat, radius 70 at z = 0 to 20 at z = 10 (slope 5, 11.3 degrees off horizontal), lofted through three fitted circles as a 1 mm wall open at both ends. The inside is the parallel cone 1 mm in, a sideways step of sqrt(26): frustum(70, 20, 10) - frustum(70 - sqrt 26, 20 - sqrt 26, 10) = 13600.324 mm3. The open ends are extrapolated from the outside's end spans, which for a cone is exact.
